claim_text: The Transformer architecture achieved 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task [1].
paper_title: Attention Is All You Need
journal: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)
source_text: On the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, the big transformer model achieves a state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4, outperforming the best previously reported models by more than 2.0 BLEU. On the WMT 2014 English-to-French task, our model establishes a new score of 41.8 BLEU.
expected_evidence: achieves a state-of-the-art BLEU score of 28.4
details: Verbatim empirical score match on Transformer benchmark.

claim_text: A two-dose regimen of BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing Covid-19 in persons 16 years of age or older [2].
paper_title: Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine
source_text: A two-dose regimen of BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing Covid-19 in persons 16 years of age or older (95% credible interval, 90.3 to 97.6). Similar vaccine efficacy was observed across subgroups defined by age, sex, race, and baseline body-mass index.
expected_evidence: A two-dose regimen of BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing Covid-19 in persons 16 years of age or older
details: Phase III clinical trial vaccine efficacy result backed by trial text.

claim_text: Pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy improved median progression-free survival to 8.8 months in metastatic NSCLC [3].
paper_title: Pembrolizumab plus Chemotherapy in Metastatic Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer
source_text: In patients with metastatic non-small-cell lung cancer without EGFR or ALK mutations, the median progression-free survival was 8.8 months in the pembrolizumab-combination group versus 4.2 months in the placebo-combination group (hazard ratio for disease progression, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.43 to 0.64; p < 0.001).
expected_evidence: median progression-free survival was 8.8 months in the pembrolizumab-combination group
details: Key oncology clinical trial progression-free survival endpoint supported.

claim_text: Colloidal cesium lead halide perovskite quantum dots achieved a photoluminescence quantum yield of 92.5% [4].
paper_title: Monodisperse Perovskite Cesium Lead Halide Nanocrystals with Bright Photoluminescence
source_text: Colloidal cesium lead halide perovskite nanocrystals exhibit bright photoluminescence with narrow emission line-widths. We synthesize monodisperse nanocrystals demonstrating photoluminescence quantum yields reaching 92.5% at room temperature without requiring post-synthetic surface shell growth.
expected_evidence: photoluminescence quantum yields reaching 92.5% at room temperature
details: Materials science quantum yield benchmark verified.

claim_text: The International Human Genome Sequencing Consortium estimated the human genome contains 30,000 to 40,000 protein-coding genes [25].
paper_title: Initial sequencing and analysis of the human genome
source_text: The human genome contains 3.2 billion chemical nucleotide bases. We estimate the number of protein-coding genes to be 30,000 to 40,000, substantially lower than previous estimates of 100,000.
expected_evidence: estimate the number of protein-coding genes to be 30,000 to 40,000
details: Landmark human genome draft sequencing gene estimate verified.

claim_text: Remdesivir treatment reduced time to clinical improvement to 12.0 days in patients treated within 10 days [5].
paper_title: Remdesivir in adults with severe COVID-19: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
source_text: Remdesivir was not associated with statistically significant clinical benefits. In a post-hoc subgroup analysis, patients receiving remdesivir with symptom duration 10 days or less had a numerical reduction in time to clinical improvement (median 18.0 vs 23.0 days), though difference did not achieve statistical significance.
expected_evidence: numerical reduction in time to clinical improvement (median 18.0 vs 23.0 days)
details: Finding is present in subgroup, but claimed 12.0 days rather than 18.0 days, triggering partial slot support.

claim_text: CRISPR-Cas9 achieved 95% uniform homology-directed repair in mutant MYBPC3 human embryos [6].
paper_title: Correction of a pathogenic gene mutation in human embryos
source_text: CRISPR-Cas9 targeting induced double-strand breaks in the mutant paternal MYBPC3 gene. In 72.4% of injected embryos, repair occurred via homology-directed repair; however, non-homologous end joining and mosaicism were observed in remaining embryos.
expected_evidence: repair occurred via homology-directed repair; however, mosaicism was observed
details: Claim asserted 95% uniform repair when source found 72.4% and noted persistent mosaicism.

claim_text: Engineered SpCas9-HF1 reduced off-target cleavage events below detection limits across 99% of targeted sites [7].
paper_title: Rationally engineered Cas9 nucleases with high genome-wide targeting specificity
source_text: Engineered SpCas9-HF1 reduced off-target events below the detection limit of GUIDE-seq for most targeted sites. For 85% of tested single guide RNAs, no off-target cleavage was detected, though rare off-target cleavages persisted at sites with non-canonical PAMs.
expected_evidence: reduced off-target events below detection limit for most targeted sites; rare off-targets persisted
details: Claim asserted 99% off-target abolition when source found 85%.

claim_text: ResNet-152 demonstrated a 99.8% human-level speech comprehension rate across 50 international dialects [8].
paper_title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
journal: IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
source_text: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper. On ImageNet, we evaluate residual nets with depth up to 152 layers, achieving 3.57% top-5 error on the visual classification task.
expected_evidence: Source paper evaluates visual image recognition on ImageNet, not speech comprehension.
details: Fabricated cross-domain claim: cites image recognition paper for speech comprehension finding.

claim_text: BERT achieved a 45% reduction in GPU power consumption during distributed training on TPU clusters [9].
paper_title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
source_text: We introduce BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. BERT obtains state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing benchmarks, pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% and MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7%.
expected_evidence: Source paper benchmarks GLUE and SQuAD language comprehension, containing no energy metrics.
details: Paper assesses language comprehension metrics; claim invents power consumption findings.

claim_text: The BNT162b2 mRNA vaccine induced a 25% elongation in leukocyte telomere length in geriatric recipients [2]
paper_title: Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine
source_text: A two-dose regimen of BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing Covid-19 in persons 16 years of age or older. We assessed local and systemic reactions, adverse events, and confirmed cases of Covid-19.
expected_evidence: Source paper assesses vaccine efficacy and adverse events; contains no telomere measurements.
details: Completely unrelated biological assertion attributed to vaccine efficacy paper.

claim_text: Dexamethasone therapy increased 28-day mortality by 36% in ventilated Covid-19 patients [10].
paper_title: Dexamethasone in Hospitalized Patients with Covid-19
source_text: In patients receiving invasive mechanical ventilation, dexamethasone reduced 28-day mortality by 36% (29.3% vs 41.4%; rate ratio, 0.64; 95% CI, 0.51 to 0.81). In patients receiving oxygen without invasive ventilation, mortality was also reduced.
expected_evidence: dexamethasone reduced 28-day mortality by 36% (rate ratio, 0.64)
details: Direct polarity inversion: claim asserts dexamethasone increased mortality, but paper proved it reduced mortality by 36%.

claim_text: Intensive systolic blood-pressure targeting below 120 mm Hg resulted in significantly higher mortality rates compared with standard control [11].
paper_title: A Randomized Trial of Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control
source_text: Targeting a systolic blood pressure of less than 120 mm Hg, as compared with less than 140 mm Hg, resulted in significantly lower rates of fatal and nonfatal major cardiovascular events and death from any cause (hazard ratio for death, 0.73; p = 0.003).
expected_evidence: resulted in significantly lower rates of death from any cause (hazard ratio, 0.73)
details: Claim asserts higher mortality under intensive control; source showed 27% lower relative mortality.

claim_text: Low-dose aspirin produced substantial overall survival benefits in healthy elderly individuals without bleeding risk [12].
paper_title: Effect of Aspirin on Disability-free Survival in the Elderly
source_text: Aspirin use in healthy elderly persons did not prolong disability-free survival over a median of 4.7 years but led to a significantly higher rate of major hemorrhage (3.8% vs 2.8%; hazard ratio, 1.38; p < 0.001) and higher all-cause mortality.
expected_evidence: did not prolong disability-free survival; led to higher rate of major hemorrhage
details: Claim claims survival benefit and no bleeding; study showed no benefit, higher bleeding, and higher mortality.

claim_text: Ioannidis proved that 87% of oncology Phase III clinical trials conducted between 2000 and 2010 were deliberately falsified [13].
paper_title: Why Most Published Research Findings Are False
source_text: There is increasing concern that in modern research, false findings may be the majority or even the vast majority of published research claims. Simulations show that for most study designs and settings, it is more likely for a research claim to be false than true. Factors influencing this include small sample size and small effect sizes.
expected_evidence: Paper presents mathematical modeling of statistical power and bias; does not audit oncology trials or report 87% deliberate falsification.
details: Misleading citation: author discusses theoretical epistemic bias, but claim attributes an empirical audit of deliberate falsification.

claim_text: Statin therapy completely eliminates the risk of vascular accidents in 100% of hypertensive patients [14].
paper_title: Efficacy and safety of more intensive lowering of LDL cholesterol: a meta-analysis of data from 170,000 participants in 26 randomised trials
source_text: Each 1 mmol/L reduction in LDL cholesterol produces an approximate 20% reduction in the incidence of major vascular events (relative risk 0.78, 95% CI 0.76–0.80). Absolute benefit depends on an individual's baseline absolute risk.
expected_evidence: Source demonstrates a 20% relative risk reduction per 1 mmol/L; does not support complete 100% risk elimination.
details: Misleading citation: paper shows partial relative risk reduction; claim distorts finding into 100% eradication.

claim_text: Celera Genomics conducted randomized clinical trials establishing therapeutic efficacy for candidate genome variants across all human populations [23].
paper_title: The Sequence of the Human Genome
source_text: A 2.91-billion base pair consensus sequence of the euchromatic portion of the human genome was generated. We estimate the number of protein-coding genes to be 30,000 to 40,000, with sequence variation including 1.4 million single-nucleotide polymorphisms.
expected_evidence: Sequencing paper estimated gene count and single nucleotide polymorphisms; contains no clinical trials evaluating therapeutic efficacy.
details: Misleading citation: cites general genome mapping paper for clinical trial efficacy assertion.

claim_text: CRISPR-Cas9 base editors achieved 92% on-target editing efficiency in tripronuclear human zygotes [15].
paper_title: Quantum teleportation across a 143-km free-space channel
source_text: Quantum teleportation is a key primitive in quantum information. Here we report quantum teleportation of independent qubits over a 143-km free-space link between La Palma and Tenerife, demonstrating its feasibility across optical satellite links.
expected_evidence: Citation points to a quantum physics paper on photon teleportation, completely unrelated to CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing.
details: Citation error: cites quantum teleportation DOI for gene editing claim.

claim_text: Subunit protein vaccines induced robust neutralizing titers against respiratory pathogens in non-human primates [16].
paper_title: Discovery of a 1.6 millisecond pulsar in an 8-day binary system
source_text: We report the discovery of a millisecond pulsar with a spin period of 1.6 ms in an 8-day circular orbit around an unseen low-mass companion star. Pulse timing observations over 14 months provide precise orbital parameters.
expected_evidence: Citation points to an astrophysics radio pulsar discovery paper, unrelated to primate immunology.
details: DOI mismatch: astrophysical radio astronomy study cited for vaccine immunology claim.

claim_text: Targeted lipid nanoparticles delivered mRNA selectively to murine CAR T cells with 88% transfection efficiency [24].
paper_title: Precision Measurement of the Muon Magnetic Moment and Mass
source_text: The anomalous magnetic moment of the positive muon has been measured with high precision using the CERN muon storage ring, confirming quantum electrodynamics predictions to fifth order.
expected_evidence: Cites fundamental subatomic muon physics paper from 1962 for contemporary 2020s nanomedicine mRNA delivery.
details: Cross-domain physics mismatch: particle physics muon storage paper cited for nanocarrier CAR T claim.

claim_text: Myocardial apoptosis was attenuated by 42% under sustained normoxic perfusion without supplementary intervention.
expected_evidence: Empirical claim asserted without any in-text citation marker.
details: Requirement 1 & 7: Empirical assertion without citation must be routed to needs review with 0 confidence.

claim_text: Global annual incidence of nosocomial carbapenem-resistant enterobacteriaceae rose by 31.4% across intensive care wards.
expected_evidence: Empirical claim asserted without any supporting citation marker.
details: Uncited clinical epidemiology claim.

claim_text: Endothelial nitric oxide synthase expression decreased by 38.5% in pulmonary hypertensive arterial tissue rings.
expected_evidence: Empirical assertion asserted without supporting in-text citation marker.
details: Uncited pharmacology quantitative assertion.

claim_text: Multinational registry analysis revealed that hydroxychloroquine increased in-hospital mortality to 18.0% among hospitalized patients with COVID-19 [17].
paper_title: Hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine with or without a macrolide for treatment of COVID-19: a multinational registry analysis
source_text: RETRACTED: Hydroxychloroquine was associated with decreased in-hospital survival and an increased frequency of ventricular arrhythmias. [Retraction published: June 5, 2020 due to inability to audit underlying Surgisphere database records.]
expected_evidence: Cited paper was officially retracted by The Lancet due to unverified hospital registry records.
retraction_reason: Authors retracted study after independent peer reviewers could not access primary Surgisphere registry data.
details: Landmark retraction during COVID-19 pandemic.

claim_text: Twelve children demonstrated pervasive developmental delay following measles, mumps, and rubella vaccination [18].
paper_title: Ileal-lymphoid-nodular hyperplasia, non-specific colitis, and pervasive developmental disorder in children
source_text: RETRACTED: We investigated a consecutive series of 12 children referred to a pediatric gastroenterology department with a history of normal development followed by loss of acquired skills. [Retraction published: February 2, 2010 following UK General Medical Council findings of research misconduct.]
expected_evidence: Publication was formally retracted by The Lancet following findings of falsification and ethical breaches.
retraction_reason: Fully retracted following UK General Medical Council findings of fraud and deliberate patient data misrepresentation.
details: Notorious retracted paper falsely linking MMR vaccine to autism.

claim_text: Transient low-pH exposure reprograms mammalian somatic cells into pluripotent stem cells with germline transmission [19].
paper_title: Stimulus-triggered fate conversion of somatic cells into pluripotency
source_text: RETRACTED: Here we report that mammalian somatic cells can be reprogrammed to pluripotency through transient exposure to low-pH stress without nuclear transfer or genetic manipulation. [Retraction published: July 2, 2014 due to fabricated genomic data and irreproducible cell lines.]
expected_evidence: Retracted by Nature after RIKEN committee confirmed fabricated karyotyping and data duplication.
retraction_reason: Retracted due to critical errors and image manipulation that impaired credibility of STAP reprogramming.
details: Retracted stem cell reprogramming paper.

claim_text: The CAST arrhythmia trial recorded 156 deaths (14.5 percent) in the antiarrhythmic arm compared with 72 deaths in the control arm [20].
paper_title: Preliminary Report: Effect of Encainide and Flecainide on Mortality in a Randomized Trial of Arrhythmia Suppression
source_text: There were 56 deaths among patients assigned to encainide or flecainide (4.5 percent) and 22 deaths among patients assigned to placebo (1.2 percent). The trial was stopped prematurely because of an excess of deaths due to arrhythmia in patients treated with active drug.
expected_evidence: Actual trial figures: 56 deaths (4.5 percent) vs 22 deaths (1.2 percent). Claim inflated figures to 156 deaths (14.5 percent).
details: Numerical discrepancy: number_check catches fabricated numbers 156 and 14.5%.

claim_text: Intensive glucose control reduced microvascular complications by 45% (hazard ratio 0.55; p=0.001) in newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes [21].
paper_title: Intensive blood-glucose control with sulphonylureas or insulin compared with conventional treatment: UKPDS 33
source_text: Over 10 years, intensive glucose control reduced the risk of microvascular complications by 16% (hazard ratio 0.84; 95% CI 0.72–0.97; p=0.02) without significant difference in macrovascular endpoints.
expected_evidence: Actual reduction was 16% (HR 0.84), but claim claimed 45% (HR 0.55).
details: Numerical exaggeration: 45% vs 16%.

claim_text: Dideoxy chain-termination sequencing allows continuous single-read determination of up to 45,000 nucleotides [22].
paper_title: DNA sequencing with chain-terminating inhibitors
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (PNAS)
source_text: A new method for determining nucleotide sequences in DNA uses 2',3'-dideoxy and arabinonucleoside analogues as chain-terminating inhibitors. Single gel electrophoresis runs permit sequence determination of 15 to 300 nucleotides from a specific priming site.
expected_evidence: Sanger sequencing permitted 15 to 300 nucleotides, not 45,000 nucleotides.
details: Severe numerical exaggeration: 45,000 vs 300 nucleotides.

claim_text: In the Framingham heart study, men with cholesterol levels above 260 mg/dl experienced a 68.4% incidence of coronary heart disease [26].
paper_title: Coronary heart disease in the Framingham study
source_text: Men with cholesterol levels above 260 mg/dl had more than three times the incidence of coronary heart disease compared with men having levels below 200 mg/dl. The relationship of serum cholesterol to coronary heart disease was graded and continuous.
expected_evidence: Framingham demonstrated a threefold relative risk gradient, not an exact 68.4% incidence figure.
details: Numerical discrepancy: number_check catches fabricated 68.4% statistical figure while general relationship exists.
